CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS section_lesson (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    section_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES section(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT section_lesson_section_lesson_unique UNIQUE (section_id, lesson_id)
);

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'lesson'
          AND column_name = 'section_id'
    ) THEN
        INSERT INTO section_lesson (id, section_id, lesson_id, "order", status, created_at, updated_at)
        SELECT
            uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:section_lesson:' || l.section_id::text || ':' || l.id::text),
            l.section_id,
            l.id,
            l."order",
            1,
            l.created_at,
            l.updated_at
        FROM lesson l
        WHERE l.section_id IS NOT NULL
        ON CONFLICT (section_id, lesson_id) DO UPDATE
        SET "order" = EXCLUDED."order",
            status = EXCLUDED.status,
            updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at;
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS lesson_section_order_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_lesson_section_id;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS section_lesson_section_order_unique_idx
    ON section_lesson (section_id, "order");

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_section_lesson_lesson_id
    ON section_lesson (lesson_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_section_lesson_section_id
    ON section_lesson (section_id);

ALTER TABLE lesson DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS section_id;
ALTER TABLE lesson DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS "order";
